quick_facts.sprint_goal: Accountants can view and export revenue/VAT reports. Managers see a live chart dashboard. First full-stack feature where backend+frontend ship together in one sprint.

content.tldr: Reporting frontend consumes the Sprint 5 reporting API. Manager dashboard gets a revenue chart (last 7 days). Accountant gets a date-range report page with CSV export button.

features_committed.title: Reporting Frontend
features_committed.rationale: Reporting API is live from Sprint 5. Frontend consumption completes the accountant user story.

T037: Route guard: /reports accessible to accountant + store-manager + admin only

features_committed.title: Manager Dashboard — Revenue Chart
